description:
Windows Imaging Component for HEIC files

Windows Imaging Component for HEIC, HEIF files

This software add support to open heic files in windows or other software like IrfanView.
This software uses libheif (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif)
v1.0.8 - 2026-04-19
- Fix palette and thumbnail return value
- Implement GetDecoderInfo / GetEncoderInfo
- Decode image during CopyPixels
- Remove GetPreview implementation
- installer: Add UI
